title: Just for Fun 2 | Deluxe Seaside Carriage Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Just for Fun 2 is a chic Seaside cottage steps from Central Square and East Ruskin Beach, featuring private outdoor spaces, and full Seaside amenity access.
description_expanded: Just for Fun 2 Features - 3-Minute stroll to the E Ruskin Beach Pavilion - FOUR houses away from Seaside Town Center. 1 Minute stroll to shopping, dining, and events - 2-Minute stroll to Adult Pool, Family Pool, and Seaside Fitness Center - Enjoy 2 Taxi Bikes with your stay, perfect for exploring Seaside and 30A - Full kitchen with oven, stove, fridge, ice maker, and Keurig coffee maker - Dining table with seating for 4 and breakfast bar seating for 2 - 2nd floor living area with TV - Covered balcony with outdoor dining and cushioned outdoor sectional sofa - Fenced-in backyard with outdoor dining and built-in natural gas grill - Stacked washer and dryer on the 1st floor - WIFI and cable - Please note that both fireplaces in this cottage are decorative only and are not functional - Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, additional bike rentals, and more - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) - Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Area summer camps and kids' classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee- At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Perfectly located in the middle of Seaside, Just for Fun 2 is a wonderfully comfortable and chic cottage for your family to enjoy the best of 30A. You can't beat this location - 1 minute walk to shopping and dining in Seaside Square, 3-minute walk to the beach, and 2-minute walk to multiple pools and the fitness center. The cottage is FOUR houses away from Seaside Town Center and 1 block to Ruskin Place Park. While you will be close to the sights and hotspots of Seaside, Just for Fun 2 also offers a peaceful escape from the crowds. Enjoy the fenced-in backyard with outdoor dining and summer kitchen under the pergola. The top floor features a deluxe covered balcony with outdoor dining, outdoor sectional sofa, and a ceiling fan. The private outdoor spaces are an oasis after a day at the beach and pool. The cottage features a full kitchen, dining, and living room on the 2nd floor. The kitchen is stocked with everything you may need to enjoy cooking or whipping up snacks. Plus, there is enough room for multiple helpers to assist with meal prep! The living room includes comfortable seating, a queen sleeper sofa, and a TV when it is time to wind down. Just for Fun 2 is perfect for your crew to come together and make memories to last a lifetime. There is a detached main home on the other side of the courtyard. If you would like to add the main home, which sleeps 12 in 5 suites, please ask for details. The video tour walks you through the main home and cottage home, and you can skip ahead to 1 min 20 seconds to only view the cottage home.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, ceiling fan, shades on all windows, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and double vanity sink
1st Floor King Suite 2 | TV, ceiling fan, shades on all windows, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub and vanity sink
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in the 2nd floor living room
